mapper.sql: user_id, user_name, password, phone, avatar, intro, role, status, register_time, address
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (user_name, password, phone, avatar, intro, role, status, register_time) VALUES (#{userName}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{avatar}, #{intro}, #{role}, #{status}, #{registerTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET status = #{status} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password} WHERE user_id = #{userId}

where.if: AND (user_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR phone LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user ORDER BY user_id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT CAST(user_id AS CHAR) AS userId,user_name AS userName,avatar,intro FROM sys_user WHERE user_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password=#{newHash} WHERE user_id=#{id} AND password=#{oldHash}
